marketing_description: DeWALT® DCG422B Right Angle Die Grinder delivers a 20 V brushless motor that runs at 25,000 RPM, housed in a lightweight aluminum shell finished in yellow. The 1/4‑inch collet and barrel‑grip handle with rubber grip allow precise control via a trigger switch, while the compact right‑angle design fits tight workspaces. Compatible with 20 V MAX batteries, the tool measures 4‑1/2 in long, 2‑1/5 in wide, and 2‑1/2 in deep, operating from 0 to 125 °F.
